notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, two Clue tokens and two Food tokens, and causing the defending player to lose at least 2 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
